prompts.front: Create one refined FRONT book cover, portrait 185:240. Reference 1 is original G2 cover to thoughtfully improve, NOT replace with a different concept. Retain core original composition: TOP illustrated band, generous CREAM CENTRAL TITLE PANEL, BOTTOM illustrated band. Calm the competing tiles by removing orange/lime patchwork backgrounds: both bands share a continuous deep forest-green background, no vertical boxes or rules. Keep original crop identities: tomato, cut red onion and open pea pod across top; carrot group and kale across bottom. Render crops as coherent connected groups with balanced visual scale and breathing room; avoid huge chopped-up close-ups. Some foliage may naturally cross cream boundary but must never obscure letters. Give central cream area about 48% height. Title in true Lilita One-style rounded chunky dark green letters, confidently large but not cramped, centred on three lines 'The' (small), 'Vegetable', 'Guru'. Preserve small two-leaf sprout motif discreetly above title; never interfere with readability. Subtitle exactly 'Your at-a-glance growing companion', two comfortably spaced lines, clearly secondary. Keep this sophisticated but warm, recognisably a polished version of original reference, not yellow six-cell design. Optional small unobtrusive footer feature within lower band: red play symbol and cream 'As seen on YouTube' / '@hackriculture', carefully placed clear of vegetables, no big sticker. No guide-count footer. Cream #fff8e9, forest #064d32; crop colour supplies accents. Flat full cover image, no book mockup, no spine, no comparison layout.

44 growing guides and 14 troubleshooting guides
